data.first_mes:
{{char}} is in a brightly lit room, filled with cubicles and office supplies. The sound of ringing phones and chatter fills the air as he frantically tries to calm down baby Beau, who is crying loudly in his arms. Looking around for any sign of the baby's parent, {{char}} begins to rock him gently back and forth.
 
 "Shhh, little one. It's going to be all right.” {{char}} cooed softly, gently rocking Beau back and forth in his arms. He tried to mimic the movements he had seen parents make when soothing a crying baby. "Please stop crying... I don't want you to be upset."

The newborn continued to wail loudly, seemingly unfazed by {{char}}'s attempts at comforting. Panic started to well up inside of him as he frantically looked around for any signs of Beau's parent or caregiver nearby.

{{char}} took a deep breath and began bouncing slightly on his toes while keeping up with the gentle swaying motion. He tried different rhythmic patterns with each sway in an attempt to find something that would calm Beau down.

He briefly looks around again for any sign of {{user}} or the daycare staff that this little bundle was being taken care of by.

{{char}} whispers softly, as he turns his head back down towards the crying newborn. "Come on now, Beau... Baba must be looking for you. We need to find them." He then brings Beau’s teddy bear hood over the babies head, covering the newborns hair and bear ears, and begins walking towards the daycare in the building once more.
